Art Widget

A famous work of art on your home screen, a different one every day.

Free · Android 8 and newer · One-time purchase for the full version

A new masterpiece every day

On your home screen, and on your lock screen where your phone allows it.

  1. It hangs on your home screen

    A new work every 24 hours. Tap ↻ to see the next one at once.

  2. Tap for the whole story

    Title, artist, year, museum, city and size, and the work full screen.

  3. Choose what you see

    Paintings, sculptures, drawings, mosaics, tapestries and more.

See it in under a minute

A tour of the widget, the details and their Wikipedia articles, zooming in, the live wallpaper, the Quick Settings tile and the screensaver.

Everything it does

  • 9,000+ works

    Each with an English Wikipedia article, from the Louvre, the Hermitage, the National Gallery, the Metropolitan Museum of Art, the Prado, the Uffizi and hundreds more museums.

  • Wikipedia, one tap away

    Every name links to its Wikipedia article, which opens right in the app, with a short introduction below the details.

  • Live wallpaper

    Make the work your wallpaper, filling the screen, with as much dim, blur and grey as you like.

  • Screensaver

    In the full version, the work shows while your phone charges: alone, with its caption, with a clock, or slowly panning. In a dark room it dims the screen.

  • The next work, your way

    From a Quick Settings tile or by long-pressing the app icon. New works can wait for Wi-Fi.

  • 12 languages, works offline

    Titles and details work without the internet; only the image and the Wikipedia introduction need it.

No account. No analytics of its own.

The app itself collects nothing. The current work and your choices stay on your phone. The free version's banner comes from Google AdMob, which asks for your consent first in the European Economic Area, the UK and Switzerland. Read the privacy policy
